examples.note: Pyongyang — area code 2; the 381 block includes lines reachable from abroad

notes: International connectivity is heavily restricted: most calls into North Korea require operator assistance via +850 2 18111, and only selected numbers can be dialled directly.
Calls between North and South Korea are banned outside the former Kaesong Industrial Region.
NSN length varies — roughly 8 digits for Pyongyang landlines and 10 for mobile numbers.
sources: ITU-T E.164 assigned country codes: https://www.itu.int/pub/T-SP-E.164D
